First, I need to authenticate your account by looking up your user ID.

2) **First name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I can access your orders, I’ll list everything by order (including what’s pending vs delivered) and then we’ll confirm before I make any changes.

Thank you so much for understanding. I really appreciate your help—it’s just been a lot lately, you know? Anyway, I can give you my email address to look up my account. It’s silva7872@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else from me!
